text:
Alyssa M: Hey design — need a compact visual pack for next week's 'Inference Economics' webinar. One hero diagram (how serving wins vs model ownership), three microtiles (latency, cost, reliability), plus a single-slide benchmark explainer for the webinar deck. Brand-compliant, localization-ready. Deadline: Tue noon PT.

Jess D: Got it. Quick Qs: final copy for tiles? languages? and do you want animated GIFs or static PNGs for socials?

Alyssa M: Copy is mostly final — I'll drop a doc in a sec. Start with EN, then we localize to DE/FR/JA if time. Socials: static PNGs + 1 short GIF for the hero.

Matt R: tagging @Jess D — I'll hand off the base diagram layout in Figma. Prefer to keep it as vector SVGs for sales and PNG exports for social.

Jess D: perfect. Can you paste the Figma file and the frame names? also need export specs.

Matt R: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/inference-econ-visuals — frames: HERO_MASTER, TILE_LATENCY, TILE_COST, TILE_RELIABILITY, BENCH_EXPLAINER. Export: SVG (1x) for assets, PNG 1200x628 for socials, PNG 1080x1080 for microtiles, GIF 1200x628 3-5s loop for hero.

BrandBot: heads-up: primary accent #1565D8 does not meet AA contrast at 12px on white for captions. Use #0F4CB0 for small text or increase size. Also include ALT text for each tile.

Alyssa M: good catch — use #0F4CB0 for captions. I'll add alt copy in the doc.

Jess D: file notes: will produce 3 size variants per tile (1080, 720, 480) for responsive. Will include a Figma component library and a single-file 'deliverables checklist' frame. ETA: Mon EOD for first pass.

Sanjay P: can we add a tiny overlay that shows 'unit cost saving %' on the cost tile? I can supply the stat and a 1-line annotation for the explainer slide.

Alyssa M: yes — stat is "~35% unit saving with prefix caching + batching". Put it in parentheses on the cost tile and callout on the explainer slide.

Jess D: noted. Also: localization: leave text layers as separate, use auto-layout for expandable tiles. Will export separate language pages.

Kara (Legal): quick legal check — avoid naming customers or specific customer savings. Stat wording ok as an aggregate. Also keep the trademark notice in the footer of the explainer slide.

Alyssa M: thanks Kara. Add the TM footer to BENCH_EXPLAINER frame.

Jess D: sharing a mini brief and an initial frame in the figma now. Will ping when first pass is up for review.

Alyssa M: awesome — once first pass is in, I'll do copy QA and hand over to localization. If all looks good we can push the hero GIF to socials Wed morning. :rocket:

BrandBot: compliance checklist (quick): 1) AA contrast for text 14px+, 2) ALT text for all images, 3) accessible color-blind palette option, 4) footer legal line present on explainer.

Jess D: adding an accessibility variant (higher contrast) as an extra frame. Also will include a short README in the figma with export filenames and naming conventions.

Alyssa M: OK — thanks team. If anyone hits blockers call out here. Also, please tag me in the figma comments with "Ready for review".

Matt R: will do. Cheers.
